I'm attempting to combine these dates into a single cell D1 to display a range from the B1 date to the C1 date formatted as 'From 01-Jan to 05-Jan' using the formula '="From "&B1&" to "&C1'. from pathlib import Path

import tempfile

# Load the workbook
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
ws = wb.active

# Modify cells D1 through D10 with the corrected formula
# The solution is to use TEXT function to format the dates
# Formula: ="From "&TEXT(B1,"dd-mmm")&" to "&TEXT(C1,"dd-mmm")
for row_idx in range(1, 11):  # D1 to D10
    cell = ws.cell(row=row_idx, column=4)  # Column D
    # Set the formula with TEXT function to format dates properly
    cell.value = f'="From "&TEXT(B{row_idx},"dd-mmm")&" to "&TEXT(C{row_idx},"dd-mmm")'

# Save to a temporary file first

    temp_path = tmp_file.name

# Move the temporary file to the final destination
